item.title: GTA 6's Most Heartbreaking Scene Is Exactly Why You Had To Do All Those Chores
item.description: Jason repairs the steps leading up to his and Lucia’s home, fixes a railing, buys groceries, orders flowers, paints the walls of their bedroom, and more to prepare for Lucia’s arrival from prison. All those chores might seem less thrilling than the opening hours you’d expect in a big-budget action game. But it turns out they set up a tragic heartbreak I simply did not see coming.

item.title: How to flip your car in GTA 6
item.description: Flipping your car in Grand Theft Auto 6 works a bit differently than it did in previous games. In Rockstar's bid for realism, the team made it so you can't flip your car while you're still in it. Instead, whichever character you're controlling will have to get out of the car and turn it over. Note that flipping only works on certain vehicles, though. You can flip cars, boats, even larger construction vehicles, but not planes.

item.title: Vice City portal Easter egg location in GTA 6
item.description: The Vice City portal Easter egg is a unique event in Grand Theft Auto 6 that lets you travel through time. It might not look like it, but the existence of a secret portal in Leonida is quite plausible, considering the UFOs appearing in the skies and the forgotten haunted hotels you can visit.

item.title: How to get your car out of the impound in GTA 6
item.description: It doesn't take long for one of your cars to end up at the police impound in Grand Theft Auto 6 . You might have abandoned it near a crime scene, or they arrested you while you were driving it. While the circumstances may vary, you have only two ways to proceed if a car is impounded: you forget about it or you retrieve it.

item.title: Best way to reveal the map in GTA 6
item.description: Revealing your map in Grand Theft Auto 6 is no easy task, as the map is huge . Defogging the map isn't necessary to complete the game, but it's nice to see what each area has to offer. By uncovering it, you can see every clothing store, gas station, Pay 'N' Spray, and more.

item.title: GTA 6's Staggering Sales Still Might Never Catch GTA 5
item.description: Take-Two said that GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies during its pre-release period, and that through the end of launch day on Nov. 19, it had racked up $3.79 billion in revenue.

item.title: The Witcher 4 Will Be a GTA 6-Sized Leap Forward, CD Projekt Red Says
item.description: We're living in a post- Grand Theft Auto 6 world now, meaning that almost every other game in development will inevitably be compared to Rockstar Games' new open-world crime drama. The developer behind two other big open-world brands, The Witcher and Cyberpunk, is now fielding questions about how its future games will stack up against GTA 6 .

item.title: The One Thing to Know About Jason and Lucia Before You Play Too Much GTA 6
item.description: Even after clearing Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s long story, I keep finding myself drawn back to Leonida. That’s thanks in large part to Jason and Lucia, a pair of charismatic protagonists that I genuinely enjoy spending time with. While you can treat them as independent characters and take them out on solo adventures, GTA 6 shines brightest when you travel around Leonida as a pair. In fact, you’re bound to miss a whole lot if you aren’t letting Jason and Lucia enjoy a date from time to time.

item.title: GTA 6 Data Reveals Only 40% of Players Have Cleared Chapter 2
item.description: If your feed is full of clips and streams from people who’ve already gone deep into Grand Theft Auto 6 , here’s some reassurance: most players aren’t as far along as you probably think.

item.title: Amazon Confirms Rings of Power Season 4's Status Ahead of Season 3 Finale
item.description: The third season of Rings of Powe r , Amazon's Lord of the Rings series on Prime Video, is set to conclude on Tuesday, Nov. 24 with the release of its final two episodes. That is, of course, if you didn't catch the seventh episode early in theaters. Before the credits roll, Amazon has revealed that fans will be getting more of Rings of Power soon as the show has been renewed for a fourth season.
